verification_scope: HogQL 컴파일·실행, 저장된 인사이트 실행, 대시보드 강제 재실행, 원격 ID·쿼리·레이아웃 재조회. 모두 빈 결과이며 실제 수신 표본/원장 대조 검증은 미완료. 합성 CTE 표본으로 중복 제거·취소·갱신 지연·미완료 NULL·잔액 0·미분류 거래·장소 시간 합계 오류 제외도 확인했습니다. 합성 표본은 실제 이벤트로 수집하지 않았습니다.
changes: 한국 시간 날짜 경계의 Date→String→DateTime 변환으로 런타임 오류 수정
nullable timestamp의 toDate 변환 전 문자열 변환으로 런타임 오류 수정
미지원 quantileExactIf를 quantileExact(if(..., value, NULL))로 변경해 미완료 표본 제외
건설 관측의 시간 합계 검증 추가 및 timestamp 하한 적용
새 카드 제목·설명과 안내 카드에 미계측 표시
limits: 필수 이벤트 4종이 최근 30일 수집 목록과 이벤트 조회에 없음
서버 사건에 프로젝트 제외 필터가 실제로 어떻게 적용되는지는 수신 표본이 없어 미검증
중복 전달·상태 변경·일일 전수 스냅샷·원장 일치·완료 기록 대응 검증은 계측 구현 및 배포 후 필요
SQL을 실행했을 때 {filters}가 보존되며 저장된 인사이트의 filterTestAccounts=true를 유지함

cards.title: 건물별 건설 진행 상황 · 미계측
cards.sql:
WITH filtered_events AS (SELECT * FROM events WHERE {filters}), construction_raw AS (
 SELECT timestamp, toString(properties.island_id) AS island_id,
  toString(properties.attempt_id) AS attempt_id,
  toString(properties.building_id) AS building_id,
  toString(properties.stage) AS stage,
  toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.observation_version)) AS observation_version,
  toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.selected_at_ms)) AS selected_at_ms,
  toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.saving_seconds)) AS saving_seconds,
  toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.ready_wait_seconds)) AS ready_wait_seconds,
  toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.build_seconds)) AS build_seconds,
  toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.elapsed_seconds)) AS elapsed_seconds
 FROM filtered_events
 WHERE event = 'island_construction_observed' AND properties.analytics_environment = 'production'
  AND properties.metrics_schema_version = 1
  AND properties.analytics_excluded = 0
  AND timestamp >= toDateTime(toString(toDate(toTimeZone(now(), 'Asia/Seoul')) - INTERVAL 27 DAY), 'Asia/Seoul') AND timestamp <= now()
  AND toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.selected_at_ms)) >= toUnixTimestamp(toDateTime(toString(toDate(toTimeZone(now(), 'Asia/Seoul')) - INTERVAL 27 DAY), 'Asia/Seoul')) * 1000
  AND toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.selected_at_ms)) <= toUnixTimestamp(now()) * 1000
), construction_latest AS (
 SELECT island_id, attempt_id,
  argMax(tuple(building_id, stage, saving_seconds, ready_wait_seconds, build_seconds, elapsed_seconds, timestamp), observation_version) AS latest
 FROM construction_raw
 WHERE island_id != '' AND attempt_id != '' AND observation_version >= 1
 GROUP BY island_id, attempt_id
), attempts AS (
 SELECT island_id, attempt_id, latest.1 AS building_id, latest.2 AS stage,
  latest.3 AS saving_seconds, latest.4 AS ready_wait_seconds,
  latest.5 AS build_seconds, latest.6 AS elapsed_seconds, latest.7 AS observed_at
 FROM construction_latest
 WHERE latest.1 IN ('hall', 'board', 'gram', 'library', 'mail', 'tower', 'shop')
  AND latest.2 IN ('waiting_balance', 'waiting_contribution', 'ready', 'building', 'completed', 'cancelled')
  AND latest.3 >= 0 AND latest.4 >= 0 AND latest.5 >= 0 AND latest.6 >= 0
  AND abs(latest.3 + latest.4 + latest.5 - latest.6) < 0.001
)
SELECT building_id AS "건물", uniqExact(island_id) AS "섬 수", count() AS "선택한 목표",
 countIf(stage IN ('waiting_balance', 'waiting_contribution', 'ready')) AS "착수 전",
 countIf(stage = 'building') AS "공사 중", countIf(stage = 'completed') AS "완공",
 countIf(stage = 'cancelled') AS "취소·변경",
 countIf(stage NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled') AND observed_at < now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS "상태 갱신 지연"
FROM attempts GROUP BY building_id ORDER BY building_id

cards.title: 건물을 짓는 데 걸린 시간 · 미계측

  AND toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.selected_at_ms)) <= toUnixTimestamp(now()) * 1000
), construction_latest AS (
 SELECT island_id, attempt_id,
  argMax(tuple(building_id, stage, saving_seconds, ready_wait_seconds, build_seconds, elapsed_seconds, timestamp), observation_version) AS latest
 FROM construction_raw
 WHERE island_id != '' AND attempt_id != '' AND observation_version >= 1
 GROUP BY island_id, attempt_id
), attempts AS (
 SELECT island_id, attempt_id, latest.1 AS building_id, latest.2 AS stage,
  latest.3 AS saving_seconds, latest.4 AS ready_wait_seconds,
  latest.5 AS build_seconds, latest.6 AS elapsed_seconds, latest.7 AS observed_at
 FROM construction_latest
 WHERE latest.1 IN ('hall', 'board', 'gram', 'library', 'mail', 'tower', 'shop')
  AND latest.2 IN ('waiting_balance', 'waiting_contribution', 'ready', 'building', 'completed', 'cancelled')
  AND latest.3 >= 0 AND latest.4 >= 0 AND latest.5 >= 0 AND latest.6 >= 0
  AND abs(latest.3 + latest.4 + latest.5 - latest.6) < 0.001
)
SELECT building_id AS "건물", countIf(stage = 'completed') AS "완공 표본",
 countIf(stage NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled')) AS "아직 진행 중", countIf(stage = 'cancelled') AS "취소·변경",
 if(countIf(stage = 'completed') = 0, NULL, quantileExact(0.5)(if(stage = 'completed', saving_seconds / 3600.0, NULL))) AS "준비 중앙값 시간",
 if(countIf(stage = 'completed') = 0, NULL, quantileExact(0.5)(if(stage = 'completed', ready_wait_seconds / 3600.0, NULL))) AS "착수 대기 중앙값 시간",
 if(countIf(stage = 'completed') = 0, NULL, quantileExact(0.5)(if(stage = 'completed', build_seconds / 3600.0, NULL))) AS "공사 중앙값 시간",
 if(countIf(stage = 'completed') = 0, NULL, quantileExact(0.5)(if(stage = 'completed', elapsed_seconds / 3600.0, NULL))) AS "전체 중앙값 시간",
 if(countIf(stage = 'completed') = 0, NULL, quantileExact(0.9)(if(stage = 'completed', elapsed_seconds / 3600.0, NULL))) AS "전체 90백분위 시간"
FROM attempts GROUP BY building_id ORDER BY building_id

cards.title: 매일 들어오고 나간 물고기 · 미계측
cards.sql:
WITH filtered_events AS (SELECT * FROM events WHERE {filters}), transaction_raw AS (
 SELECT timestamp, toString(properties.island_id) AS island_id,
  toString(properties.transaction_id) AS transaction_id,
  toString(properties.reason) AS reason, toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.amount_delta)) AS amount_delta
 FROM filtered_events
 WHERE event = 'island_currency_transaction' AND properties.analytics_environment = 'production'
  AND properties.metrics_schema_version = 1
  AND properties.analytics_excluded = 0
  AND timestamp <= now() AND toDate(toString(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Seoul'))) >= toDate(toTimeZone(now(), 'Asia/Seoul')) - INTERVAL 27 DAY
), transaction_latest AS (
 SELECT island_id, transaction_id, argMax(tuple(timestamp, reason, amount_delta), timestamp) AS entry
 FROM transaction_raw WHERE island_id != '' AND transaction_id != ''
 GROUP BY island_id, transaction_id
), transactions AS (
 SELECT island_id, transaction_id, entry.1 AS occurred_at, entry.2 AS reason, entry.3 AS amount_delta
 FROM transaction_latest WHERE entry.3 IS NOT NULL AND entry.3 != 0
)
SELECT toDate(toString(toTimeZone(occurred_at, 'Asia/Seoul'))) AS "날짜",
 sumIf(amount_delta, amount_delta > 0) AS "들어온 물고기",
 -sumIf(amount_delta, amount_delta < 0) AS "나간 물고기",
 sum(amount_delta) AS "순증감"
FROM transactions GROUP BY "날짜" ORDER BY "날짜"

cards.title: 물고기는 어디서 벌고 어디에 쓸까 · 미계측
cards.sql:
WITH filtered_events AS (SELECT * FROM events WHERE {filters}), transaction_raw AS (
 SELECT timestamp, toString(properties.island_id) AS island_id,
  toString(properties.transaction_id) AS transaction_id,

  AND properties.metrics_schema_version = 1
  AND properties.analytics_excluded = 0
  AND timestamp <= now() AND toDate(toString(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Seoul'))) >= toDate(toTimeZone(now(), 'Asia/Seoul')) - INTERVAL 27 DAY
), transaction_latest AS (

)
SELECT if(amount_delta > 0, '입금', '출금') AS "방향",

 sum(abs(amount_delta)) AS "물고기 수", count() AS "거래 수", uniqExact(island_id) AS "거래한 섬 수"
FROM transactions GROUP BY "방향", "원인" ORDER BY "방향", "물고기 수" DESC

cards.title: 섬 통장에는 얼마나 남아 있을까 · 미계측
cards.sql:
WITH filtered_events AS (SELECT * FROM events WHERE {filters}), wallet_latest AS (
 SELECT toString(properties.island_id) AS island_id,
  argMax(tuple(toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.balance)), timestamp), tuple(toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.wallet_version)), timestamp)) AS latest
 FROM filtered_events
 WHERE event = 'island_wallet_snapshot' AND properties.analytics_environment = 'production'
  AND properties.metrics_schema_version = 1
  AND properties.analytics_excluded = 0
  AND timestamp <= now()
  AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
  AND toString(properties.island_id) != '' AND toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.wallet_version)) >= 0
 GROUP BY island_id
), wallets AS (
 SELECT island_id, latest.1 AS balance FROM wallet_latest WHERE latest.1 >= 0
)
SELECT count() AS "확인한 섬 수", countIf(balance = 0) AS "잔액 0인 섬",
 round(100.0 * countIf(balance = 0) / nullIf(count(), 0), 2) AS "잔액 0 비율 퍼센트",
 round(avg(balance), 2) AS "평균 잔액", quantileExact(0.5)(balance) AS "중앙값 잔액",
 quantileExact(0.9)(balance) AS "상위 10퍼센트 경계 잔액", sum(balance) AS "관측 섬 잔액 합계"
FROM wallets HAVING count() > 0

cards.title: 섬과 바다 중 어디서 집중할까 · 미계측
cards.sql:
WITH filtered_events AS (SELECT * FROM events WHERE {filters}), focus_raw AS (
 SELECT timestamp, person_id, toString(properties.record_id) AS record_id,
  toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.duration_seconds)) AS duration_seconds,
  toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.island_seconds)) AS island_seconds, toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.sea_seconds)) AS sea_seconds,
  toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.unknown_seconds)) AS unknown_seconds
 FROM filtered_events
 WHERE event = 'focus_location_summary' AND properties.analytics_environment = 'production'
  AND properties.metrics_schema_version = 1 AND timestamp <= now() AND toDate(toString(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Seoul'))) >= toDate(toTimeZone(now(), 'Asia/Seoul')) - INTERVAL 27 DAY
), focus_latest AS (
 SELECT record_id, argMax(tuple(person_id, timestamp, duration_seconds, island_seconds, sea_seconds, unknown_seconds), timestamp) AS latest
 FROM focus_raw WHERE record_id != '' GROUP BY record_id
), sessions AS (
 SELECT record_id, latest.1 AS person_id, toDate(toString(toTimeZone(latest.2, 'Asia/Seoul'))) AS focus_day,
  latest.3 AS duration_seconds, latest.4 AS island_seconds, latest.5 AS sea_seconds, latest.6 AS unknown_seconds
 FROM focus_latest
 WHERE latest.3 > 0 AND latest.4 >= 0 AND latest.5 >= 0 AND latest.6 >= 0
  AND abs(latest.3 - latest.4 - latest.5 - latest.6) < 0.001
), location_rows AS (
 SELECT person_id, focus_day, record_id, '섬' AS location, island_seconds AS seconds FROM sessions
 UNION ALL SELECT person_id, focus_day, record_id, '바다' AS location, sea_seconds AS seconds FROM sessions
 UNION ALL SELECT person_id, focus_day, record_id, '미확인' AS location, unknown_seconds AS seconds FROM sessions
)
SELECT location AS "장소", uniqExactIf(person_id, seconds > 0) AS "집중한 사람",
 uniqExactIf(record_id, seconds > 0) AS "해당 장소 포함 세션", round(sum(seconds) / 60.0, 2) AS "총 집중분",
 round(100.0 * sum(seconds) / nullIf((SELECT sum(duration_seconds) FROM sessions), 0), 2) AS "집중시간 비중 퍼센트"
FROM location_rows GROUP BY location ORDER BY "총 집중분" DESC
